Context: Revised guidelines for passport issuance

- (i) IC should be on official stationery. NOC can be on plain paper with signature/ stamp. Pl is to be submitted on plain paper.  
- (ii) Telephone, fax and e-mail id of the Controlling/ Administrative Office should be indicated in all the three documents.
- (iii) Military/ Air Force/Navy personnel with Clo. APO address may submit applications at their station of posting or at their permanent address. Spouse (adult children, if spouse expired/ divorced) can receive passport with authority letter.
